_schema.PROCESS_NAME: string (required) - process whose action item entity is the editor/filter context
_schema.SUBPROCESS_NAME: string (required) - subprocess used for the subprocess context
_schema.UNKNOWN_ID: string (required) - UUID that is not an action item entity
_schema.INVALID_CONTEXT_TYPE: string (required) - contextType that is not an EntityTypeEnum value
_schema.ILLEGAL_ARGUMENT_ERROR_CODE: string (required) - errorCode for an invalid contextType
_schema.EXPECTED_EDITOR_FIELDS: object (required) - editor field names per group (header group keyed _header), sorted
_schema.EXPECTED_EDITOR_DEFAULTS: object (required) - sorted default value keys per editor field that has defaults
_schema.EXPECTED_USER_PICKERS: string[] (required) - sorted editor field names rendered as user pickers
_schema.EXPECTED_FILTERS: object (required) - sorted filter names keyed by GATEWAY_TYPE (AZURE, GRAVITEE)
_schema.EXPECTED_FILTER_CODES: object (required) - sorted value keys of the status, priority and actionType filters
